work.name: Ernst & Young (EY) India
highlights: Delivered data-privacy and protection advisory for a telecommunications client against GDPR, ISO 27701:2025 (PIMS), and regional data-protection regulations, conducting a privacy gap assessment and risk assessment.
Performed Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) and built data flow diagrams and Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), strengthening the client's privacy compliance maturity.
Delivered recommendations and implementation roadmaps, prepared management reports for stakeholders, and responded to RFPs and client proposals for prospective engagements.

work.name: PwC India (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
highlights: Conducted IT and OT cybersecurity audits and IT General Controls (ITGC) testing against ISO 27001:2022 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF 2.0), delivering maturity assessments, risk reports, and remediation recommendations that improved client security posture by up to 40%.
Identified control gaps and developed security policies, procedures, and As-Is / To-Be network diagrams aligned to regulatory standards, reducing compliance gaps by 30%.
Maintained risk registers and used Tenable, Nessus, Nozomi, and Claroty to assess vulnerabilities, triage findings by severity, and support remediation, cutting critical vulnerabilities by 25%.
Built Power BI dashboards and metrics to communicate risks and control gaps to stakeholders, and coached clients through ISO 27001 certification readiness.
